nodes.description: NEK8 R45W and K157Q reduce ciliary PC2 localization when expressed in Nek8-null IMCD3 cells; I150M did not show this defect. This rescue assay does not itself establish dominant-negative interference in a heterozygous patient.
nodes.id: Variant-dependent loss of ciliary polycystin-2 localization

evidence.reference_title: Certain heterozygous variants in the kinase domain of the serine/threonine kinase NEK8 can cause an autosomal dominant form of polycystic kidney disease.
evidence.snippet: However, Nek8 knockout IMCD3 cells expressing NEK8-p.Arg45Trp and NEK8-p.Lys157Gln showed significantly decreased polycystin-2 but normal ANKS6 localization in cilia.

nodes.description: Reduced polycystin function at vascular sites is implicated in arterial complications. The tissue mechanisms are less resolved than the renal epithelial pathway and are not effects of renal-cell cilia on every extrarenal organ.

evidence.snippet: The localization of polycystins to other phenotypic sites (e.g., the vascular system) indicates that reductions in the level of these proteins underlie disease complications such as intracranial aneurysms
